In [[30 BBY/Legends|30 BBY]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Tholme/Legends|Tholme]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]], undertook a '''mission''' to [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]]. However, what began as a simple assignment to mediate disputes within the [[Twi'lek Ruling Council|Twi'lek Clan Council]] erupted into a kidnapping incident, when [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] [[Morgukai]] warriors [[Tsyr]] and [[Bok]] captured [[Nat Secura]], the heir to [[Clan Secura]].
